categories.label: Data Rights
categories.description: The rights individuals have over their personal data, including access, correction, deletion, and portability.

categories.label: Legal Bases for Processing
categories.plainLabel: Why Companies Are Allowed to Use Your Data
categories.description: The valid legal reasons an organization must have before collecting or using personal data.

categories.label: Sensitive Data
categories.plainLabel: Extra Protection for Your Most Sensitive Information
categories.description: Special categories of personal data that receive stronger legal protection.

categories.label: Transparency and Notice
categories.plainLabel: Your Right to Know How Your Data Is Used
categories.description: Requirements for organizations to inform individuals about data collection and use.

categories.label: Vendor and Processor Management
categories.plainLabel: Rules for Companies That Handle Data on Your Behalf
categories.description: Requirements for contracts and oversight of third parties that process personal data.

categories.label: Breach Notification
categories.plainLabel: What Happens When Your Data Is Compromised
categories.description: Requirements to notify regulators and individuals when personal data is exposed.

categories.label: International Data Transfers
categories.description: Rules governing when and how personal data can be transferred to other countries.

categories.label: Automated Decision-Making
categories.plainLabel: Your Rights When Algorithms Make Decisions About You
categories.description: Requirements and restrictions on decisions made solely by automated systems.

categories.label: Privacy Impact Assessments
categories.plainLabel: Checking the Privacy Risks Before You Start
categories.description: Requirements to assess privacy risks before starting high-risk processing activities.

categories.label: Privacy Governance
categories.plainLabel: How Organizations Must Manage Privacy Internally
categories.description: Requirements for internal privacy programs, officers, and record-keeping.

categories.label: Enforcement and Penalties
categories.plainLabel: Who Enforces These Rules and What Happens If You Break Them
categories.description: The regulatory authorities and penalties that apply for non-compliance.
